symptom: A failed full-fleet certification emitted a report with passed=false but returned exit code 0 when structured JSON output was requested, allowing an exit-code-only CI gate to appear green.
whyGateMissed: The CLI checked report.Passed only after the human-readable output branch; the JSON branch returned immediately, and no CLI regression test asserted both the emitted report and process result.
earliestDetection: Exercise the certification result emitter with a failed report in JSON mode and require complete JSON output together with a non-nil command error.
